entry_points.text: Main decode consumes supplied bytes or pulls from the guest stream, sets default widths, walks legacy markers, resolves extension/vector prefixes, selects descriptors via primary/extended/group tables, screens enforcement/feature eligibility, decodes addresses and operands, repairs addresses and reports success/failure with fault flagging.

Execution validates lock eligibility, far shapes, 64-bit exclusions and undefined markers, checks extension availability and OS support, flushes numeric faults, materializes media operands, consults intercepts around permission/memory stages, enforces mode/privilege faults, handles repeat counts and memory reads, dispatches via handlers or single-byte logic, then retains updates.

Synic-to-vCPU and vCPU-to-synic map via containing Hyper-V records; synic retrieval needs lookup, present state and active flag. Frame translation shifts off offset; timer marking records the index, raises service and optionally kicks.

Running-vCPU accessor returns current processor or null under brief preemption suppression. Debugging availability is a read-only capability-bit test gating host/guest paths. Synic registers are read via a helper mapping control/version/pages/end and lines.

Management interrupts inject only with advertised base, one build always unavailable, raising dedicated requests; nonmaskable increments a queue and raises its request. Single-vCPU injection forwards mode/vector/level/trigger to acceptance.
Synthetic routing ignores deassertions and fails without a controller; end-of-interrupt acknowledges all lines on the retiring vector; global refresh caches global numbers into addressed lines.

exports.text: Decoded state exposes a paging-update test and cache maintenance: discard cached registers, commit them back, and test whether direct guest-physical access is allowed.
Guest extended state is exchanged around execution by load and put helpers with usage checks, tracing and a reload count; key-protection state is restored separately.
Guest memory helpers clear a byte range to zero and write a page slice, resolving slots and host addresses and marking pages dirty on success.
A helper records that a guest frame became dirty inside a slot; a missing slot makes the call a no-op.
Interrupt delivery is a thin wrapper over a full routine that tries an accelerated path then falls back to scanning all vCPUs for matching destinations.

hazards.text: Decode refuses when host enforcement is active with shadow-stack/branch-tracking enabled, consulting both privilege configs for far and current level for near, with access failures also refusing. High-table escape indexes are speculation-hardened. Pending exception numbers outside range fail emulation while flagging presence; intercepted/unhandleable map distinctly without commit.

Legacy markers: size overrides 102/103, segments 38/46/54/62/100/101, lock 240, repeats 242/243, extension 64-79 in 64-bit only; vector leads 196/197, escape 15 with selector 56. Vector widths are 16 for short/streaming and 32 for long, 8 for media; media file holds 8 entries 0-7.

Host page writes reject cross-page, unmapped/read-only or failed copies, marking dirty only on success. Empty/inverted zap intervals, slot miscalculation, missing ranges, negative nesting and overlong writes warn or trap rather than corrupt.

Recording dirtiness without a running vCPU while the VM has users is denied generically and warns. Pushing to a full ring warns yet proceeds; reaching soft threshold raises a scheduling request to expedite harvesting.
Hashed selection hitting disabled targets sets a sticky per-VM flag with a one-time notice. Physical broadcast with lowest-priority demotes to fixed with notice to avoid undefined arbitration.

Synic exposes 16 consecutive lines 0-15; APIC base occupies one frame invalidated on inhibit and completion covers 16 sources. Delivery modes cover fixed/lowest/management/nonmaskable/init/startup/remote-read/external with physical/logical targeting. Dirty entries use a dedicated valid flag; debugging uses six registers with control/pending diverting.

invariants.text: Default widths follow mode: 2/2 for real/virtual-86 without promotion and 16-bit protected, 4/4 for 32-bit protected and promoted real, 4/8 for 64-bit; size markers toggle paired widths with distinct pairing in 64-bit.

Selectors map to registers, immediates of varied width and sign, fixed accumulators, string memory at string registers, combined registers under masking, far pointers and constant segments; unknown suppresses retention. After group resolution branch character is recorded, empty and mis-annotated descriptors are rejected, widths are corrected for stack/branch/extension forms and callbacks captured. Init clears relativity, prefix, lock, size/repeat, validity/dirty and cursors.

Repeating string compare/scan completes when repeat flavor contradicts the zero condition; restart on progress with buffered input clears cached reads and commits registers. Two-byte handling treats cache/prefetch/nop as success, routes control/debug moves via hooks, applies conditional move/branch/set from flags, and widens narrow sources by zero/sign extension.

Direct guest-physical use is refused for repeat-prefixed strings or dual-memory ops. FPU load assumes idle and put assumes in-use with a reload event. Numeric helper surfaces deferred faults as numeric exceptions; media refresh and raw reads occur only for media kinds with index 0-7.

Synthetic sources are read atomically; masked report no vector, unmasked expose low bits; connection and auto-EOI are decided by scanning for matching vectors. Programming validates vectors, stores atomically and refreshes membership. Ack redrives enabled non-direct timers with pending messages then forwards to mapped globals; global ack walks synchronized notifiers for matches.

vCPU lookup by index rejects out-of-range, fast-paths slot equality then scans. Index resolves to stored Hyper-V value when present else creation position with acquire ordering; synic retrieval needs successful lookup, present state and active flag.

Clearing walks page-bounded segments from the start offset using a shared zero page; each segment is capped at the page remainder. Host resolution fails for missing/invalid or read-only-on-write slots with optional page-count reporting; error addresses are recognized against the direct-map boundary.

Sparse sizing rounds max vCPUs by bank density; extended-call limit is a fixed offset past query. Rmap zap iterates address spaces and overlapping slots clamped to boundaries, skipping empty. Inhibit manipulation checks reason-table size at build time, toggles bits and traces.

Dirty accounting needs a present slot with tracking active, storing slot-relative offsets with combined space/slot identity. With ring capacity and a running vCPU reports go to that ring else to slot bitmaps. Publish writes identity/offset, barriers, sets valid, advances producer; occupancy is producer-minus-consumer with power-of-two masking for full/soft-full tests.

Without debugging capability guest accesses fail while host succeed; unknown debug registers are ignored with success. Inactive synic reads fail for guests but succeed for hosts; unknown synic registers fail, and end-of-interrupt reads as zero with atomic line reads.

Enabled needs both software and hardware indications under a global switch plus in-kernel presence. Fixed delivery drops edge deassertions and disabled-controller traffic and syncs trigger memory. Matching normalizes identifiers, honors shorthand, then physical/logical rules with broadcast acceptance, cluster checks and quirk-dependent broadcast recognition.

Lowest-priority applies for that mode or redirection hints; arbitration compares counters. Hashed delivery picks the nth set bit by vector modulo eligible count. Guest timestamps add per-CPU offsets after optional ratio scaling skipped at default ratio via fixed-point multiply.

locks.text: Media and numeric paths acquire floating-point context before raw register or wait operations and release afterwards with paired sections.

Vector bitmap updates ignore low vectors and on empty/non-empty auto transitions with virtualized interrupts take the APICv update lock in write mode to adjust counts and inhibit reasons. Inhibit updates require that lock, ignore unneeded reasons, merge window state, request all-CPU updates on transitions and invalidate the default page when inhibiting; frame translation shifts off page offset.

Frame-range zap takes the MMU lock in write mode, brackets with invalidate markers, records the range, removes rmap and two-dimensional leaves, and flushes remote buffers only when removals occurred; leaf removal asserts write ownership and visits all valid roots with yielding.

Running-vCPU lookup pins via preemption disable around per-CPU read. Accelerated delivery handles self without tables, others under read-side protection of the destination map. Routing refresh observes the table via sleepable read-side access with the interrupt lock held.

state_machines.text: Prefix scan loops over size/segment/lock/repeat and 64-bit extension bytes, discarding extension state when legacy follows; wide bit widens width, then leading byte selects vector, two/three-byte or primary maps. Vector handling rejects prior legacy state, expands short form, inverts polarity, derives extension/map/vector selectors, requires 64-bit when extended, treats one map as unhandled and synthesizes size/repeat.

Emulation tail writes back destinations unless flagged no-write, restores saved kinds, advances string pointers, decrements repeat counts with restart-vs-finish handling, then maps internal completions to external outcomes with conditional commit.

Invalidate tracking nests with a counter, starts invalid on outermost entry, widens to minimal cover of concurrent requests, then on exit advances a sequence with ordering before decrementing and warns when nothing was recorded.

Synic programming validates vectors, stores atomically, refreshes old/new membership and requests controller scan. Register writes reject inactive except host clearing, handle control/version/event/message pages with guest exits and conditional zeroing, fan out end-of-message, delegate numbered sources and reject unknowns. Exits capture control/event/message state and raise requests.

Debug register reads/writes update matching fields with success; guest control/pending writes divert to userspace while host complete inline and other registers never divert. Diversion fills an exit descriptor with snapshots, installs completion and raises exit; completion copies back status only for control origin.

Synthetic line delivery checks in-kernel controller and range, drops when no vector armed, else builds fixed self-directed physical edge requests. Acceptance branches by mode: fixed/lowest share edge/enable checks, remote-read wakes, management/nonmaskable inject and kick, init arms pending, startup latches vector with ordering, external ignored.

Map resolution rejects non-self shorthands, missing maps and broadcasts; physical indexes flat tables with hardening, logical delegates by format with minimal-arbitration or hashed selection. Slow path clears a bitmap, skips absent/nonmatching, injects directly except lowest-priority which defers to single selection.
Reference counter returns scaled kernel clock unless the timestamp page is ready, else reads first-vCPU stamp, applies guest scaling then Hyper-V scale plus offset.

structs.text: Emulation context holds mode, widths, prefix and opcode state, descriptor flags, address scratch, three operands, shared memory template with fixup, cursors and exception/intercept callbacks; each operand carries kind, length, register/segmented-memory/immediate addressing and current/original values.
Fixed-width SIMD aliases describe 16- and 32-byte values with views as 64-bit halves or 32-bit lanes plus constructors and selectors.

Per-vCPU synthetic state holds control, version, event/message page addresses, active and zero-suppress flags, source registers with vector and auto-EOI bitmaps and global mappings, plus timers with pending/enable/direct/source-index config.
Each vCPU owns a dirty queue with capacity, producer and consumer positions, soft threshold and entries carrying combined slot identity, slot-relative offset and valid flag.

Synthetic debugging lives per-VM with control/status plus send/receive/pending descriptors and options. Identity sources include numeric ID for extended mode, legacy ID from register high byte, mode bit and generic register reader; cached map supports disabled/extended/flat/cluster organizations.
